name: roamproxy-mcp
description: Fetch pages and get proxies through residential, datacenter and mobile IPs in 190+ countries.
long_description: Lets Claude browse the web through your RoamProxy account: fetch any URL from a residential IP in a chosen country, state or city, build proxy URLs for Playwright/curl/antidetect browsers, verify the exit IP, and check your balance. Traffic is billed to your RoamProxy wallet as usual.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch a URL through a RoamProxy IP in the chosen country/state/city

tools.name: get_proxy
tools.description: Build a ready-to-use http/socks5 proxy URL for any geo, rotating or sticky

tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Show the exit IP, city and ISP for a geo/session

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Wallet balance, prices, 7-day usage and static IPs
